# Tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tools_doc.py from the server's tool registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

All tools return JSON. Errors of the domain (bad path, simulation not idle, MATLAB unreachable, CarMaker
refusing something) come back as tool errors with a plain message; invalid arguments are rejected by the
input schema before anything runs.

Each tool is marked for MCP clients as **read-only**, **changes state** or **destructive** (overwrites
or discards something; all of these are logged and most can be undone with `cm_revert_all`).

Optional tools are registered only when their group is named in `CM_ENABLE`
(`tcl`: raw Tcl in the CarMaker GUI (cm_gui_tcl), `experimental`: Simulink structure edits (cm_model_add_block, cm_model_add_line, cm_model_delete_block)). Groups that can be switched off with `CM_DISABLE` to shorten the tool list:
`standalone` (independent CarMaker processes without MATLAB (cm_standalone_*)), `study` (parameter studies (cm_study_*)), `matlab` (MATLAB workspace and Simulink parameters (cm_*_workspace_*, cm_model_*)), `movie` (IPGMovie pictures (cm_movie_*)).

Resources: `carmaker://guide` (how to use the server), `carmaker://status`, `carmaker://changelog`,
`carmaker://log`. Prompts: `run_and_summarise`, `compare_settings`, `undo_session`.

## Setup

### `cm_session_start`

*Start the CarMaker for Simulink session* · changes state

Bring up a CarMaker for Simulink session as far as it is missing: start MATLAB (visible, in the project's src_cm4sl folder, engine shared), run cmenv, open the Simulink model and open the CarMaker GUI. Nothing is restarted or closed. Returns ready=true, or ready=false with what it is waiting for: call again until ready. Without a model it opens none and lists models_loaded and models_found to choose from. Many projects need their own setup script before the model compiles: if init_scripts_found lists one, pass it as init.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string or null | null | Simulink model to open: a name on the MATLAB path, a path as listed in models_found, or a full path (default: CM_MODEL) |
| `max_wait_s` | number | `45.0` | Longest time to wait in seconds; keep it below your client's tool time-out and call again if not finished |
| `init` | string or null | null | The project's own MATLAB setup script, run once per MATLAB session before the model is opened (default: CM_MATLAB_INIT). A name from init_scripts_found, or a full path |

### `cm_doctor`

*Check the setup* · read-only

Check the setup: CarMaker install, Python version, MATLAB release and engine, shared MATLAB session, GUI, project folder. Each failed check comes with its fix.

## Run control

### `cm_status`

*Simulation status* · read-only

Simulation state, active Simulink model, project directory, last end status, the GUI's storage mode (save_mode) and gui_all_saved (false: the GUI holds unsaved data and will ask before a load; true is no guarantee, an edit in an open editor window is not counted).

### `cm_load_testrun`

*Load a test run* · changes state

Load a test run into the CarMaker GUI. Requires an idle simulation. Find names with cm_list('testrun').

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Test run relative to Data/TestRun, e.g. 'Examples/BasicFunctions/Driver/BackAndForth' |
| `force` | boolean | `false` | Do not let the GUI ask about unsaved data; that data is discarded |

### `cm_start_sim`

*Start the simulation* · changes state

Start the loaded test run. Returns once it is running; fails at once, with Simulink's error, if the model does not compile. Then call cm_wait_end until it reports finished.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start_timeout_s` | number | `90.0` | How long the start may take (a Simulink model may compile first) |
| `save` | `save` \| `collect` \| `keep` | `"save"` | save: write a result file (GUI storage mode becomes 'Save all', cm_revert_all puts it back). collect: buffer only. keep: leave the GUI setting alone |
| `save_logs` | boolean | `false` | Also save what Simulink logged in this run to a MAT file next to the result file, as cm_model_logs_save does; cm_wait_end returns it as logs_file |

### `cm_stop_sim`

*Stop the simulation* · destructive

Stop the running simulation. With wait_s > 0 it returns what cm_wait_end returns.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `wait_s` | number | `30.0` | Wait this long for the simulation to become idle (0: do not wait) |

### `cm_wait_end`

*Wait for the simulation to end* · read-only

Wait until the simulation is idle again. finished=true: end status, simulation time and distance, result_file, new log errors and pop-ups. finished=false: current state and live values; call again to keep waiting.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `timeout_s` | number | `45.0` | Longest time to wait in seconds; keep it below your client's tool time-out and call again if not finished |
| `poll_s` | number | `1.0` | Seconds between status polls |

### `cm_log`

*Read the CarMaker session log* · read-only

Last lines of the newest CarMaker session log of the project. Use it when a run aborts or does not start.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lines` | integer | `50` | Number of lines from the end |
| `level` | `all` \| `warning` \| `error` | `"all"` | warning: warnings and errors only; error: errors only |

### `cm_live`

*Read live quantities* · read-only

Current values of CarMaker quantities during a run (or the last values after it).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quantities` | list of string | required | CarMaker quantity names, e.g. ['Time', 'Car.v'] |

### `cm_dva_write`

*Overwrite a quantity (DVA)* · changes state

Overwrite a quantity during a run via Direct Variable Access.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Quantity to overwrite, e.g. 'DM.Gas' |
| `value` | number | required | Value, offset or factor, depending on mode |
| `duration_ms` | integer | `-1` | How long the override lasts in ms (-1: until released or the run ends) |
| `mode` | `Abs` \| `Off` \| `Fac` \| `AbsRamp` \| `OffRamp` \| `FacRamp` | `"Abs"` | Absolute value, offset or factor; Ramp variants blend in |

### `cm_dva_release`

*Release DVA overrides* · changes state

Release all quantities from DVA control.

### `cm_popups`

*Read GUI pop-ups* · changes state

Pop-up messages the CarMaker GUI raised for this server's commands (type info/warn/err/question, text, index of the answer given) and the current pop-up timeout. Reading empties the GUI's buffer (it keeps five). cm_load_testrun, cm_start_sim and cm_wait_end already return new ones as 'popups'.

### `cm_popup_timeout`

*Let GUI pop-ups answer themselves* · destructive

Let GUI pop-ups raised by this server's commands answer themselves with their DEFAULT choice, so that a question such as 'Vehicle not saved. All changes will be lost. OK to continue?' cannot block a run. The default answer there discards the unsaved changes. Read what was answered with cm_popups. Stays until set back, cm_revert_all or a GUI restart.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | number | required | Seconds until a pop-up answers itself; 0 = never shown; -1 = wait for a click in the GUI (the normal setting) |

### `cm_gui_tcl`

*Run Tcl in the CarMaker GUI* · destructive · optional, needs `CM_ENABLE=tcl`

Run a Tcl / ScriptControl command in the CarMaker GUI. Escape hatch with a small deny-list (exit, exec, cd, file delete...). Logged. Prefer the dedicated tools.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | string | required | Tcl / ScriptControl command |
| `timeout_ms` | integer | `10000` | Time-out in ms (0: do not wait for the result) |

## Results

### `cm_results_list`

*List result files* · read-only

Newest .erg result files under the project's SimOutput folder, CM_RESULT_DIRS and the folders this session's runs wrote to.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer | `30` | Maximum number of files |

### `cm_results_summary`

*Summarise a result file* · read-only

First / last / min / max / mean and unit of quantities in a result file, plus rows and duration.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `erg` | string | required | Result file (.erg): absolute path, or relative to the project |
| `quantities` | list of string or null | null | Quantities to summarise (default: Time, Car.v) |
| `search` | string or null | null | Instead of a summary, list the quantity names that contain this text ('PT.') or match this wildcard pattern ('Car.v*'; '*' lists all) |

### `cm_results_read`

*Read time series from a result file* · read-only

Time series from a result file, decimated to at most max_points samples.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `erg` | string | required | Result file (.erg): absolute path, or relative to the project |
| `quantities` | list of string | required | CarMaker quantity names, e.g. ['Time', 'Car.v'] |
| `t_min` | number or null | null | Start of the time window in s |
| `t_max` | number or null | null | End of the time window in s |
| `max_points` | integer | `500` | Samples are thinned to at most this many per quantity |

### `cm_output_quantities`

*Read the output quantities* · read-only

The quantities the next run writes to its result file, per storage rate (names may hold wildcards), with the sample times. movie_replay says whether such a result file can be replayed in IPGMovie. What a finished result file holds: cm_results_summary(erg, search='*').

### `cm_output_quantities_edit`

*Change the output quantities* · destructive

Add quantities to, or remove them from, the project's output-quantities file (backed up first, logged, restored by cm_revert_all). Applies from the next start. Requires an idle simulation. Find names with cm_live (it reads any quantity) or in another result file.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `add` | list of string or null | null | Quantities to store as well, e.g. ['Car.az', 'PT.Motor*.Trq']; wildcards * and ? allowed |
| `remove` | list of string or null | null | Entries to take out, spelled as they are listed |
| `rate` | `fast` \| `normal` \| `slow` | `"normal"` | Storage rate for added quantities (sample times: cm_output_quantities) |
| `preset` | string or null | null | movie: add what IPGMovie needs to replay the vehicle from a result file |

## IPGMovie

### `cm_movie_open`

*Open IPGMovie* · changes state

Open IPGMovie, CarMaker's 3D animation window (or take over one that is open). Open it BEFORE a run: it records a run only while it is open, and cm_movie_snapshot can then show any moment of it.

### `cm_movie_snapshot`

*Take a picture in IPGMovie* · changes state

A picture of IPGMovie's 3D view, returned as an image. After a run it shows any moment of the last run (time_s), provided IPGMovie was open during that run. During a run, without time_s, it shows the IPGMovie window as it is at that moment (in the window's own size). With erg it replays a saved result file, which must hold the vehicle's motion (cm_output_quantities_edit(preset='movie') before that run). Do not pass time_s during a run: that makes IPGMovie stop following the run.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `time_s` | number or null | null | Simulation time of the picture in s (default: the latest moment IPGMovie holds) |
| `camera` | string or null | null | Camera view: 'DEFAULT', "Bird's Eye View", 'Left Side', 'Right Side', 'Sitting In Vehicle (A)', or one from the project (default: keep the view) |
| `erg` | string or null | null | Replay this result file instead of the last run (absolute path, or relative to the project) |
| `width` | integer | `960` | Picture width in pixels (not during a run) |
| `height` | integer | `540` | Picture height in pixels (not during a run) |

## Project data

### `cm_list`

*List project data files* · read-only

Names of project data files of one kind (test runs, vehicles, drivers, tyres...).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `testrun` \| `vehicle` \| `driver` \| `tire` \| `road` \| `trailer` \| `kinematics` \| `config` \| `chassis` \| `misc` \| `sensor` \| `traffic` \| `script` | required | Kind of project data; selects the folder below <project>/Data |
| `pattern` | string or null | null | Wildcard filter on the name, e.g. '*Brak*' |
| `include_hidden` | boolean | `false` | Also list names starting with a dot |

### `cm_read`

*Read a project data file* · read-only

Key / value pairs of a CarMaker infofile. Large files are truncated: filter by keys or prefix.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `testrun` \| `vehicle` \| `driver` \| `tire` \| `road` \| `trailer` \| `kinematics` \| `config` \| `chassis` \| `misc` \| `sensor` \| `traffic` \| `script` | required | Kind of project data; selects the folder below <project>/Data |
| `name` | string | required | File name relative to the kind's folder, as cm_list returns it |
| `keys` | list of string or null | null | Only these keys |
| `prefix` | string or null | null | Only keys starting with this, e.g. 'Vehicle' or 'DrivMan.' |

### `cm_edit`

*Edit a project data file* · destructive

Change keys in a project file in place (backed up first, logged; only the edited lines change). Requires an idle simulation; load the test run again afterwards.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `testrun` \| `vehicle` \| `driver` \| `tire` \| `road` \| `trailer` \| `kinematics` \| `config` \| `chassis` \| `misc` \| `sensor` \| `traffic` \| `script` | required | Kind of project data; selects the folder below <project>/Data |
| `name` | string | required | File name relative to the kind's folder |
| `overrides` | object | required | Keys to set, e.g. {'Road.FName': 'SKIDPAD.rd5'}; a null value removes the key |

### `cm_clone`

*Copy a project data file* · changes state

Copy a project file to a new name in the same kind's folder. Never overwrites.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `testrun` \| `vehicle` \| `driver` \| `tire` \| `road` \| `trailer` \| `kinematics` \| `config` \| `chassis` \| `misc` \| `sensor` \| `traffic` \| `script` | required | Kind of project data; selects the folder below <project>/Data |
| `base` | string | required | Existing file to copy |
| `new_name` | string | required | Name of the copy (must not exist) |

## MATLAB workspace and Simulink

### `cm_list_workspace_vars`

*List workspace variables* · read-only

Variables (name, class, size) of the MATLAB base workspace or of a Simulink model's workspace. Controller parameters usually live in the model workspace.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scope` | string | `"base"` | 'base' for the MATLAB base workspace, or the name of a loaded Simulink model for that model's workspace |
| `pattern` | string or null | null | Wildcard filter on the name, e.g. 'Kp_*' |

### `cm_get_workspace_var`

*Read a workspace variable* · read-only

Value of a variable or field. MATLAB objects are described, not converted: read their fields.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Variable or field, e.g. 'Kp_12' or 'Table.Value' |
| `scope` | string | `"base"` | 'base' for the MATLAB base workspace, or the name of a loaded Simulink model for that model's workspace |

### `cm_set_workspace_var`

*Set a workspace variable* · destructive

Set a variable or field. The old value is logged and cm_revert_all restores it. Model-workspace changes live in memory until cm_model_save. Requires an idle simulation.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Variable or field, e.g. 'Kp_12' or 'Table.Value' |
| `value` | any | required | Number, string, list or nested list (matrix) |
| `scope` | string | `"base"` | 'base' for the MATLAB base workspace, or the name of a loaded Simulink model for that model's workspace |

### `cm_model_get`

*Read a Simulink parameter* · read-only

get_param on a loaded Simulink model or block.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Model or block path, e.g. 'MyModel/Controller/Gain' |
| `param` | string | required | Parameter name, e.g. 'Gain' |

### `cm_model_set`

*Set a Simulink parameter* · destructive

set_param on a loaded Simulink model or block. Logged; cm_revert_all restores the old value.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Model or block path |
| `param` | string | required | Parameter name |
| `value` | any | required | New value (numbers are converted to text as Simulink expects) |
| `save` | boolean | `false` | Also back up and save the model file |

### `cm_model_save`

*Save a Simulink model* · destructive

Save a loaded Simulink model. The file must be inside the project; it is backed up first.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | string | required | Name of the loaded model |

### `cm_model_logs_save`

*Save Simulink's logged data to a MAT file* · changes state

After a CarMaker for Simulink run: write what Simulink logged (signals marked for logging and To Workspace blocks) to a MAT file, with the base workspace and the model workspace as one struct each (variables: signals, base_workspace, model_workspace, info). Requires an idle simulation. The result file (.erg) holds CarMaker's quantities; this holds the Simulink side.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string or null | null | MAT file to write, inside the project (default: next to the last result file, with the same name) |
| `model` | string or null | null | Loaded Simulink model (default: the active one) |
| `logs` | `inspector` \| `workspace` \| `both` | `"inspector"` | inspector: every signal the Simulation Data Inspector holds for the last run (logged signals and To Workspace blocks, complete). workspace: the logging variables in the base workspace as they are |
| `format` | `dataset` \| `struct` | `"dataset"` | dataset: a Simulink.SimulationData.Dataset. struct: plain arrays (name, time, values, units, block) that load without Simulink |
| `base_workspace` | boolean | `true` | Include the base workspace's variables |
| `model_workspace` | boolean | `true` | Include the model workspace's variables |
| `overwrite` | boolean | `false` | Replace the file if it exists |
| `timeout_s` | number | `120.0` | Longest time MATLAB may take to write the file |

### `cm_model_add_block`

*Add a Simulink block (experimental)* · changes state · optional, needs `CM_ENABLE=experimental`

EXPERIMENTAL. add_block. Unsaved until cm_model_save; a revert reloads the model from disk.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | string | required | Library block, e.g. 'simulink/Math Operations/Gain' |
| `dest` | string | required | New block path, e.g. 'MyModel/Sub/Gain1' |
| `params` | object or null | null | Block parameters to set |

### `cm_model_add_line`

*Add a Simulink line (experimental)* · changes state · optional, needs `CM_ENABLE=experimental`

EXPERIMENTAL. add_line. Unsaved until cm_model_save.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `system` | string | required | System that contains both blocks, e.g. 'MyModel/Sub' |
| `out` | string | required | Source port as 'Block/1' |
| `inp` | string | required | Destination port as 'Block2/1' |

### `cm_model_delete_block`

*Delete a Simulink block (experimental)* · destructive · optional, needs `CM_ENABLE=experimental`

EXPERIMENTAL. delete_block. Unsaved until cm_model_save; a revert reloads the model from disk.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | required | Block path |

## Standalone instances (no MATLAB)

### `cm_standalone_servers`

*List running CarMaker programs* · read-only

CarMaker simulation programs running on this machine (pid, description, whether this server manages it). A CarMaker Office window you opened shows up once its application is started.

### `cm_standalone_launch`

*Launch a standalone CarMaker run* · changes state

Start a NEW independent CarMaker simulation program (not connected to MATLAB) and run a test run on it. Only for test runs whose vehicle does not need a Simulink controller. Results go to the project's SimOutput; see cm_standalone_results.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `testrun` | string | required | Test run relative to Data/TestRun |
| `overrides` | object or null | null | Test-run keys to change in memory only, e.g. {'Vehicle.DriverTemplate.FName': 'X'} |
| `quantities` | list of string or null | null | Quantities to store (default: Time, Car.v, Car.YawRate, Car.ax, Car.ay, Car.Distance) |
| `realtime_factor` | number | `1.0` | Simulation speed relative to real time (larger is faster) |
| `stop_after_s` | number or null | `600.0` | Safety stop at this simulation time in s (null: none) |
| `executable` | string or null | null | CarMaker executable (default: the stock one of the install) |
| `start` | boolean | `true` | Start the run at once |

### `cm_standalone_attach`

*Attach to a running CarMaker program* · changes state

Attach to a CarMaker simulation program that is already running, for example one started from a CarMaker Office window.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pid` | integer | required | Process id from cm_standalone_servers |
| `testrun` | string or null | null | Test run to configure (needed to start a run) |
| `overrides` | object or null | null | Test-run keys to change in memory only, e.g. {'Vehicle.DriverTemplate.FName': 'X'} |
| `quantities` | list of string or null | null | Quantities to store |
| `realtime_factor` | number | `1.0` | Speed relative to real time |
| `stop_after_s` | number or null | `600.0` | Safety stop at this simulation time in s |
| `start` | boolean | `false` | Start the run at once (needs testrun) |

### `cm_standalone_status`

*Standalone instance status* · read-only

State of a standalone instance plus live values.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string or null | null | Standalone instance id such as 'sa1' (may be omitted while there is only one) |
| `quantities` | list of string or null | null | Live quantities to read (default: Time, Car.v) |

### `cm_standalone_control`

*Control a standalone run* · destructive

Start, pause, resume or stop the simulation of a standalone instance.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `start` \| `pause` \| `resume` \| `stop` | required | What to do |
| `instance` | string or null | null | Standalone instance id such as 'sa1' (may be omitted while there is only one) |

### `cm_standalone_wait_end`

*Wait for a standalone run to end* · read-only

Wait until the instance's simulation has finished. finished=true: simulation time and distance, error flag and log errors. finished=false: call again to keep waiting.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string or null | null | Standalone instance id such as 'sa1' (may be omitted while there is only one) |
| `timeout_s` | number | `45.0` | Longest time to wait in seconds; keep it below your client's tool time-out and call again if not finished |

### `cm_standalone_dva_write`

*Overwrite a quantity in a standalone run (DVA)* · changes state

Overwrite a quantity in a running standalone simulation (Direct Variable Access).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | required | Quantity to overwrite |
| `value` | number | required | Absolute value |
| `duration_ms` | integer | `-1` | How long the override lasts in ms (-1: until the run ends) |
| `instance` | string or null | null | Standalone instance id such as 'sa1' (may be omitted while there is only one) |

### `cm_standalone_results`

*Result files of a standalone run* · read-only

Result .erg files of the instance's run (read them with cm_results_summary / cm_results_read).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string or null | null | Standalone instance id such as 'sa1' (may be omitted while there is only one) |

### `cm_standalone_close`

*Close a standalone instance* · destructive

Disconnect; for instances this server launched, also stop the CarMaker process.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `instance` | string or null | null | Standalone instance id such as 'sa1' (may be omitted while there is only one) |

## Parameter studies

### `cm_study_start`

*Start a parameter study* · changes state

Run one test run several times with different parameter values, one after another, in the background. Returns a study id at once; poll cm_study_status. Nothing is written to project files.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `testrun` | string | required | Test run relative to Data/TestRun |
| `variations` | list of object | required | One entry per run: {'label': 'heavy', 'keys': {'Body.mass': 320}, 'workspace': {'Kp_yaw': 1.5}}. 'keys' are infofile keys applied in memory for that run only (prefix a place such as 'Vehicle:' if needed); 'workspace' are MATLAB variables in 'scope', restored after the run. Both are optional |
| `quantities` | list of string or null | null | Quantities to summarise per run (default: Time, Car.v) |
| `mode` | `cm4sl` \| `standalone` | `"cm4sl"` | cm4sl: the MATLAB-connected session. standalone: a separate CarMaker process per run (no 'workspace' values) |
| `scope` | string | `"base"` | 'base' for the MATLAB base workspace, or the name of a loaded Simulink model for that model's workspace |
| `max_run_s` | number | `900.0` | A run is stopped after this wall time in s |
| `save_logs` | boolean | `false` | After every run, save what Simulink logged and the workspaces as that run used them to a MAT file next to its result file (mode cm4sl; logs_file per row) |

### `cm_study_status`

*Parameter study progress and results* · read-only

State of a study (running, done, cancelled, failed), the run in progress and one row per finished run: end status, simulation time, distance, result file, statistics of the requested quantities.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `study` | string or null | null | Study id (default: the latest) |

### `cm_study_cancel`

*Cancel a parameter study* · destructive

Stop the run in progress, skip the remaining ones and restore the changed workspace values.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `study` | string or null | null | Study id (default: the latest) |

## History and undo

### `cm_changelog`

*Change log* · read-only

Recorded changes (file keys, workspace variables, model parameters, GUI settings) with old and new values.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session` | string or null | null | Session id (default: this session) |
| `limit` | integer | `100` | Newest entries to return |

### `cm_revert_all`

*Undo this session's changes* · destructive

Undo every change made in this server session: workspace values and model parameters in reverse order, backed-up files put back (created files go to a trash folder), GUI settings restored.

### `cm_restore`

*Restore files of an earlier session* · destructive

Restore project files from the backups of an earlier session. Files only.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session` | string | required | Session id as shown by cm_changelog |
